summary: In 1977, residents of Circleville, Ohio, began receiving thousands of sinister, anonymous block-printed letters detailing intimate personal secrets. The campaign escalated to a suspicious fatal car crash, a booby-trapped handgun rigged to kill, and a questionable conviction—yet the letters continued arriving even while the primary suspect was held in solitary confinement.
research_points: The initial wave of targeted anonymous letters sent to Mary Gillispie and local school board members in 1977.
The fatal crash of Ron Gillispie in August 1977 following a mysterious phone call regarding the letter writer's identity.
The 1983 discovery of an unexploded booby-trap device containing a loaded handgun aimed at Mary Gillispie.
The controversial trial and conviction of Paul Freshour based on gun ownership and questioned handwriting analysis.
The continuation of the letters sent to prison wardens, journalists, and television producers while Freshour was in isolation, leaving the true author unidentified.
title: Bir Kasabayı Terörize Eden İmzasız Mektuplar: Circleville Gizemi
description: 1977 yılında Ohio'nun Circleville kasabası, bölge sakinlerinin en karanlık sırlarını detaylandıran ürpertici, isimsiz mektuplarla sarsıldı. Tehditlerle başlayan süreç; şüpheli bir ölümcül kaza, bir yol kenarına kurulan bubi tuzaklı silah ve tartışmalı bir tutuklamayla derinleşti. Ancak asıl şüpheli hücre hapsindeyken bile mektuplar yazılmaya devam etti. Gölge Arşivi, 20 yıla yayılan bu gizemli psikolojik savaşın ve faili meçhul mektupların izini sürüyor.
